reason: I read every review and check Reddit, GitHub issues, and Twitter before buying any dev tool, and this is a brand-new founding-member pre-sale with nothing to verify. I already pay for GitHub Copilot Enterprise, and I can't see what Loom adds that Copilot doesn't, so I'm not handing over money on day one.
objection: We already pay for GitHub Copilot Enterprise; why add this? And there are no reviews yet to prove Loom is worth it.
would_change_my_mind: Verified reviews from real teams on Reddit or GitHub showing Loom works alongside Copilot Enterprise and actually saves time.
